verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound webhooks that a programmatic consumer could subscribe to for Hightouch events such as sync runs. Sync alerts ('Get notified when a run fails') are an adjacent notification feature with no documented webhook delivery. Hightouch Events and the HTTP Tracking API are inbound ingestion, not outbound event subscriptions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
